description: Unit test class for BackOffActor, using Akka testkit to verify backoff behavior, message delays, backoff reset, and in-backoff status.

classes.name: BackOffActorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the BackOffActor, testing backoff delay, message handling, reset behavior, and status responses.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem for the tests.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after tests complete.

methods.name: receiveMessageAfterBackOff
methods.description: Verifies that a message is received after the backoff delay.

methods.name: backOffDuringBackOffWillDelayMessage
methods.description: Checks that messages sent during backoff are delayed appropriately and only received after backoff completes.

methods.name: backOffDelayWillBeResetAfterSomeTime
methods.description: Ensures that backoff timer resets after a certain period, affecting subsequent message delays.

methods.name: providesInformationIfCurrentlyInBackOff
methods.description: Tests that the actor correctly reports its backoff status.

methods.name: assertIsInBackOffMode
methods.description: Helper method to check actor’s current backoff state.

methods.name: maxBackOffTimeIsNotExceeded
methods.description: Verifies that the maximum backoff duration is respected and not exceeded over multiple retries.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Utility to get the minimum of two Durations.

methods.name: createBackOffConfig
methods.description: Creates a backoff configuration with specified min and max timeout durations.
